summary: Sterling Real Estate Trust filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting two routine governance actions taken September 22, 2026: amendment and restatement of the Sterling Properties, LLLP Unit Redemption Plan to extend the mandatory holding period for redemption eligibility from one to two years, and adoption of the Fourth Amended and Restated Trustee Compensation Plan clarifying compensation eligibility for non-independent trustees. No special-situation transaction occurred—no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or forced management departure. This is an ordinary current report on material definitive agreements affecting private-REIT unit liquidity terms, not a deal event.
